name: standard_surface
about: The standard surface master (pc/docs/plans/2026-10-30-master-materials-plan.md): the material planes read by material.glsl and lit by scaled.frag. Its five parameters are the catalog's own fields; every preset and entry is an instance of it. A master generated from a node graph (part 4) is one more file here with its own shader and parameters.

parameters.name: roughness
parameters.label: Roughness
parameters.tip: 0 mirror, 1 fully rough (a roughness map overrides it per texel)

parameters.name: specular
parameters.label: Specular
parameters.tip: Fraction of a dielectric's reflectance (4% at normal incidence); keep it subtle

parameters.name: metal
parameters.label: Metal
parameters.tip: 0 stone, wood, glass; 1 bare metal (tinted reflections, no diffuse light)

parameters.name: auto_height
parameters.label: Estimate the height from the colours
parameters.tip: auto_height: bumps from the texture's luminance (dark low, bright high) where it has no height.png. Global switch and strength: Graphics > Lighting quality

parameters.name: bump
parameters.label: Relief
parameters.tip: bump: this surface's multiple of the global relief depth (bump_strength)
